verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local LLM inference engine with CLI, daemon and desktop/mobile apps. Products like this can plausibly act as MCP clients, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers model serving: SSD expert offload, an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint, LoRA adapters and platform apps, with no mention of connecting MCP servers or tool calling. The OpenAI-compatible server is an adjacent feature and does not count toward this story.
